name: beads-today-bar
description: A band above the prompt with the beads closed today against a daily goal you set (today ▮▮▮▯▯ 3/5), green when met, read with bd count. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

dailyGoal.title: Daily bead goal
dailyGoal.description: How many beads you aim to close each day, 1 to 50. The today bar turns green when the beads closed today reach it.
